profiles.notes: OpenWrt 25.12.5 (apk-tools 3) on NanoPi R76S. PostgreSQL 17.5 from the official 25.12.5 feeds, normalized to rootfs-v1. Support boundary: the pinned DISTRIB_* identity is not an image fingerprint; any image matching it is accepted if it has every library in the bundle's BASE-LIBS (libc.so, libgcc_s.so.1, libreadline.so.8, libz.so.1), which the router checks before installing, and passes the loader, postgres -V and initdb checks. Qualified only on a custom 25.12.5 build (DISTRIB_TAINTS=busybox, ~1090 packages). Not supported until the signed install, reboot and update suites pass on durable storage.

Functional on Kwrt 25.12-SNAPSHOT (plan D13-D17). Unlisted: no qualified, frozen .ipk set exists. Re-advertise only with one that passes pg-bundle.sh and the device acceptance suite, after the image is pinned by revision.
